comment: Salt Bell road incidents (file reference ch. 20). Merged over the base game's pool while this level is active: the level wins by id, the base incidents keep firing (baseIncidents: true). Art: assets/incidents/header_<id>.png (16:9) and assets/incidents/walkers/<stem>.png (true-30-degree iso cut-out facing lower-left).

incidents.title: The salt mule
incidents.body: A mule caked white with salt drags a sledge of salt blocks across the pan and stops in front of the convoy. A little cracked bell clanks on its collar, out of tune. Somewhere out there a Saltman is missing his mule, and his salt.

a.label: Lead it home to Bellwell
a.result: The Bell Folk unload the salt, water the mule and pay in what they have: water. Warden Marr will hear who brought it home.

b.label: Ring its bell for the owner
b.result: The owner hears it. So does every Saltman on the pan: the crack in that bell is the only one like it, and now they know exactly where you are.
